intro.title: You already know
intro.note: Home 1 gave you the rooms (kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, garden) and the things in them (table, bed, window, wall). Home 2 gave you renting and the parts of a building (rent, landlord, neighbour, roof, stairs, upstairs). Flat, rent, landlord and upstairs come back here — everything else in this unit is new: what a place is like, what goes wrong in it, and who lives there with you.
intro.note_cz: Home 1 dal místnosti (kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, garden) a věci v nich (table, bed, window, wall). Home 2 dal bydlení v nájmu a části domu (rent, landlord, neighbour, roof, stairs, upstairs). Flat, rent, landlord a upstairs se sem vracejí — zbytek je nový: jaké to bydlení je, co se v něm rozbije a kdo v něm s tebou žije.

intro.title: Renting, bills and things that break
intro.title_cz: Nájem, účty a co se rozbije

intro.title: You will use these words in
frames: The kitchen is small but cosy. · *Kuchyň je malá, ale útulná.*
They want to renovate the old house. · *Chtějí ten starý dům zrekonstruovat.*
We had to call a plumber. · *Museli jsme zavolat instalatéra.*
The lease is for two years. · *Nájemní smlouva je na dva roky.*
He spent his childhood in a small village. · *Dětství strávil v malé vesnici.*
intro.note: **sibling** has no everyday Czech equivalent — it means a brother **or** a sister, one word for both. And a **detached** house stands alone; a **terraced** one is in a row.
intro.note_cz: sibling = sourozenec (bratr i sestra jedním slovem).

sentences.en: A detached house costs more than a flat, but you get a garden.
sentences.cz: Samostatný dům stojí víc než byt, ale máš zahradu.
accepts: A detached house costs more than a flat, but you get a garden

sentences.en: They live in a terraced house which they bought ten years ago.
sentences.cz: Bydlí v řadovém domě, který koupili před deseti lety.
accepts: They live in a terraced house which they bought ten years ago

sentences.en: The flat is more spacious than the one we saw last week.
sentences.cz: Ten byt je prostornější než ten, který jsme viděli minulý týden.
accepts: The flat is more spacious than the one we saw last week

sentences.en: The old office was cramped, so we moved to the second floor.
sentences.cz: Stará kancelář byla stísněná, takže jsme se přestěhovali do druhého patra.
accepts: The old office was cramped, so we moved to the second floor

sentences.en: The kitchen is small but cosy.
sentences.cz: Kuchyň je malá, ale útulná.
accepts: The kitchen is small but cosy

sentences.en: The flat is furnished, but the kitchen is very old.
sentences.cz: Byt je zařízený, ale kuchyň je hodně stará.
accepts: The flat is furnished, but the kitchen is very old

sentences.en: The flat is unfurnished, so we need a bed and a table.
sentences.cz: Byt je nezařízený, takže potřebujeme postel a stůl.
accepts: The flat is unfurnished, so we need a bed and a table

sentences.en: The house has a big attic, but we never go up there.
sentences.cz: Dům má velkou půdu, ale nikdy tam nechodíme.
accepts: The house has a big attic, but we never go up there

sentences.en: We rent a small storage room for the things which we never use.
sentences.cz: Pronajímáme si malou skladovací místnost na věci, které nikdy nepoužíváme.
accepts: We rent a small storage room for the things which we never use

sentences.en: You get more privacy in a house, but the garden takes every weekend.
sentences.cz: V domě máš víc soukromí, ale zahrada zabere každý víkend.
accepts: You get more privacy in a house, but the garden takes every weekend

sentences.en: The radiator in the bedroom does not get warm when the weather is cold.
sentences.cz: Radiátor v ložnici se nezahřeje, když je venku zima.
accepts: The radiator in the bedroom does not get warm when the weather is cold

sentences.en: The estate agent showed us four flats before we chose this one.
sentences.cz: Realitní makléř nám ukázal čtyři byty, než jsme si vybrali tenhle.
accepts: The estate agent showed us four flats before we chose this one

sentences.en: The tenant before us left the walls in a bad state because he had a dog.
sentences.cz: Nájemník před námi nechal zdi ve špatném stavu, protože měl psa.
accepts: The tenant before us left the walls in a bad state because he had a dog

sentences.en: The lease is for two years, but we can leave after one.
sentences.cz: Nájemní smlouva je na dva roky, ale můžeme odejít po roce.
accepts: The lease is for two years, but we can leave after one

sentences.en: The rent is low, but the utilities are not in the price.
sentences.cz: Nájem je nízký, ale energie v ceně nejsou.
accepts: The rent is low, but the utilities are not in the price
The rent is low, but the utilities aren't in the price

sentences.en: The maintenance of an old house takes every free weekend, but we like it.
sentences.cz: Údržba starého domu zabere každý volný víkend, ale baví nás to.
accepts: The maintenance of an old house takes every free weekend, but we like it

sentences.en: The wall behind the sofa is damp because the rain comes in.
sentences.cz: Zeď za pohovkou je vlhká, protože tam zatéká déšť.
accepts: The wall behind the sofa is damp because the rain comes in

sentences.en: There is a draught from the window when the wind is strong.
sentences.cz: Když fouká silný vítr, táhne od okna.
accepts: There is a draught from the window when the wind is strong
There's a draught from the window when the wind is strong

sentences.en: There is a leak in the bathroom, but nobody will pay for it.
sentences.cz: V koupelně něco teče, ale nikdo to nezaplatí.
accepts: There is a leak in the bathroom, but nobody will pay for it
There's a leak in the bathroom, but nobody will pay for it

sentences.en: There is mould in the corner because the wall is damp.
sentences.cz: V rohu je plíseň, protože je zeď vlhká.
accepts: There is mould in the corner because the wall is damp
There's mould in the corner because the wall is damp

sentences.en: We had to call a plumber because the water was cold all morning.
sentences.cz: Museli jsme zavolat instalatéra, protože voda byla celé ráno studená.
accepts: We had to call a plumber because the water was cold all morning

sentences.en: We want to decorate the room before the guests arrive.
sentences.cz: Chceme ten pokoj vymalovat, než přijedou hosti.
accepts: We want to decorate the room before the guests arrive

sentences.en: They want to renovate the old house which they bought last spring.
sentences.cz: Chtějí zrekonstruovat ten starý dům, který loni na jaře koupili.
accepts: They want to renovate the old house which they bought last spring

sentences.en: The washing is the chore which nobody in our family wants.
sentences.cz: Praní je práce, kterou nikdo u nás v rodině nechce dělat.
accepts: The washing is the chore which nobody in our family wants

sentences.en: In our household everybody cooks once a week because my mother works late.
sentences.cz: U nás v domácnosti každý jednou týdně vaří, protože máma pracuje dlouho do večera.
accepts: In our household everybody cooks once a week because my mother works late

sentences.en: He has no sibling, but his cousins visit him every summer.
sentences.cz: Nemá sourozence, ale bratranci ho každé léto navštěvují.
accepts: He has no sibling, but his cousins visit him every summer

sentences.en: My nephew is starting school in September, but he can already read.
sentences.cz: Můj synovec začne v září chodit do školy, ale už umí číst.
accepts: My nephew is starting school in September, but he can already read

sentences.en: My niece visited us when her parents were abroad.
sentences.cz: Moje neteř nás navštívila, když byli její rodiče v zahraničí.
accepts: My niece visited us when her parents were abroad

sentences.en: His stepmother taught him to cook when he was ten.
sentences.cz: Jeho nevlastní matka ho v deseti naučila vařit.
accepts: His stepmother taught him to cook when he was ten

sentences.en: They want to adopt a second child because their son has no brothers.
sentences.cz: Chtějí adoptovat druhé dítě, protože jejich syn nemá sourozence.
accepts: They want to adopt a second child because their son has no brothers

sentences.en: Grandparents spoil the children when the parents are at work.
sentences.cz: Prarodiče děti rozmazlují, když jsou rodiče v práci.
accepts: Grandparents spoil the children when the parents are at work

sentences.en: Her upbringing was strict, but she is grateful for it now.
sentences.cz: Její výchova byla přísná, ale teď je za ni vděčná.
accepts: Her upbringing was strict, but she is grateful for it now
Her upbringing was strict, but she's grateful for it now

sentences.en: He spent his childhood in a small village which has only one shop.
sentences.cz: Dětství strávil v malé vesnici, která má jediný obchod.
accepts: He spent his childhood in a small village which has only one shop

sentences.en: My generation had no phones at school, but we were never bored.
sentences.cz: Naše generace neměla ve škole telefony, ale nikdy jsme se nenudili.
accepts: My generation had no phones at school, but we were never bored

sentences.en: They got engaged in the summer and married in the spring.
sentences.cz: V létě se zasnoubili a na jaře se vzali.
accepts: They got engaged in the summer and married in the spring

sentences.en: She will inherit the house which her grandmother bought fifty years ago.
sentences.cz: Zdědí dům, který její babička koupila před padesáti lety.
accepts: She will inherit the house which her grandmother bought fifty years ago
